text.p: Net Increase in Net Assets Resulting
Net Increase in Net Assets Resulting from
NOTE: The company had its initial public offering and simultaneously acquired three finance companies and a taxicab rooftop advertising business in May 1996.
Prior to the acquisitions and IPO, the company had no operations and hence the results reported for the quarter ending March 31, 1996 have been prepared on a pro forma basis.

The company is a regulated investment company which must distribute at least 90 percent of its income to shareholders, and as a consequence, pays no corporate income tax on the amount of income distributed.
